bullets.text: In Chennai near Tidel Park, a car carrying two people plunged into a 10-foot sinkhole, highlighting widespread concerns over road conditions.
Allegations of corruption have surfaced regarding desilting work at Poondi Lake involving the use of a Chief Minister PA name, requiring vigilance.
Minister Kumar provided clarifications regarding a cave-in on the OMR road along the Chief Minister convoy route.
Housing and Urban Development Minister P. Rajkumar announced that new homes will be constructed for Srinivasanagar project area residents.
Nakkheeran TV broadcast discussions questioning water consumption and regulatory issues concerning the proposed AI City in Chennai.
Piped water supply will be suspended for 24 hours starting October 10 in Adyar, Perungudi, and Sholinganallur zones, requiring resident advisories.
CUMTA proposed a major bus-priority corridor linking Tambaram, Velachery, Pallavaram, and Taramani to improve public transit connectivity.
A mega upgrade project worth Rs 2.117 crore is planned on Chennai GST Road to integrate bus, rail, and metro services along a single corridor.
A youth was arrested under the POCSO act after harassing a 10th-grade student in Thiruvallur to love her older sister.
Avadi Corporation welcomed a new commissioner, Ambika Jain, as part of recent administrative changes in the district.
District Collector S. Kavitha instructed officials to expedite the disposal of pending atrocity cases across Thiruvallur.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that the Centre will release an AI regulation consultation paper within a month.
MeitY advised social media platforms to curb manipulated content and prioritize complaints from authorized government agencies regarding public order.
Over 4,700 government schools in Tamil Nadu faced internet disruptions after shifting to BSNL connections, impacting digital lessons.
Opposition leaders including Edappadi K. Palaniswami and Nainar Nagendran strongly criticized the state government over recent law and order incidents.
The Tamil Nadu government transferred several IAS officers, appointing Karthik as the new Home Secretary amidst opposition pressure.
DMK leader M.K. Stalin asserted that all major infrastructure development projects in Chennai bear the imprint of the DMK government.
The Chennai Metro corridor linking Poonamallee, Porur, and Vadapalani is scheduled to open for public use on October 11.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai on October 11 to inaugurate the new metro rail project and other infrastructure initiatives.
